name: ima-share-sync
description: Windows Obsidian plugin for syncing IMA articles and permitted original files, with local PDF-to-Markdown conversion.

scripts.test:js: node tests/test-main.cjs && node tests/test-dashboard-stats.cjs && node tests/test-source-binding.cjs && node tests/test-native-integration.cjs
scripts.test:ps: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-sync.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-general.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-general-folders.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-list-readiness.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-original-file-safety.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-file-title-paths.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-source-binding.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-source-selection.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-desktop-readiness.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/test-native-identity.ps1
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:js && npm run test:pdf && npm run test:markdown && npm run test:ps && npm run test:card && npm run test:identity
scripts.check: npm run verify:release && npm run test:styles && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:identity: node --test tests/test-ima-identity.mjs tests/test-desktop-identity.mjs tests/test-folder-destinations.mjs tests/test-silent-directory.mjs tests/test-identity-picker.mjs
